p03Remediation.rootCause: computeTopLevelSpans defined a node's coverage span as [charStart, nextNode.charStart) - never reading the node's own real charEnd. Any real content between a node's true end and the next recognized node's start (or after the last node) was silently attributed to the preceding node.
p03Remediation.fix: Replaced with computeTopLevelSubtreeSpans, using each top-level node's own real, clamped [charStart, charEnd). computeUncoveredRegions now classifies every gap by shape (LEADING/INTERIOR/TRAILING/WHOLE_DOCUMENT) via a new gapKind field on UncoveredSpan.

beforeAfterProof.before: Mid-document and trailing swallows both produced coveragePercent=100, significantUncoveredSpans=[], health=STRUCTURE_HEALTHY.
beforeAfterProof.after: Mid-document swallow (test D): coveragePercent=2.24, health=STRUCTURE_PARTIAL, 1 significant uncovered span, gapKind=INTERIOR, span=[50,5050). Trailing swallow (test D2): coveragePercent=1.09, health=STRUCTURE_PARTIAL, gapKind=TRAILING.

p03Remediation.regressionTest: tests/foundation-audit/discovery-fail-closed.test.ts (D/D2, updated from documenting-the-bug to proving-the-fix per the architecture-proposal-node-identity.test.ts precedent)
p03Remediation.generalizedVariants: tests/foundation-audit/structural-coverage-remediation.test.ts (23 new tests): varied gap sizes/positions, positive control (genuinely healthy document still reports healthy, no false-positive explosion), negative control.

p04Remediation.rootCause: raw-source-fallback.ts's routing trigger (coverage-audit/pipeline.ts's skip condition) was computed from the same defective structural-coverage output, so the ONE independent safety net for structural gaps never ran when P0-3's bug reported false-healthy - a live reproduction of Architecture Invariant #18.
p04Remediation.fix: Skip condition now also checks for SIGNIFICANT boundary anomalies (new mechanism, see below), and when present, raw-scans that anomaly's own suspect region (never the whole document) in addition to any real gaps. partitionUncoveredSpan's parameter loosened to a minimal RawScanSpanRef so both real gaps and boundary anomalies route through the same partitioner.
p04Remediation.newCapability: Boundary-anomaly detection (BoundaryAnomalyFinding, computeBoundaryAnomalies) - needed because Q1/Q5's defect class is not a coverage GAP at all (every character is nominally 'covered', just by the wrong node). Three generalized signals per ARTICLE/SECTION/SUBSECTION node: EMBEDDED_HEADING_LIKE_FRAGMENT (a second heading-shaped match found inside a node's own claimed text, using a deliberately more permissive regex than stage-structure.ts's own so it catches the colon-defeat case), SIGNAL_DENSITY_SHIFT (2+ distinct clause-marker tokens with zero real children), OWN_TEXT_LENGTH_OUTLIER (WARNING-only, never gates health on its own).
p04Remediation.beforeAfterProof: The Q1-shaped colon-defeat case (zero coverage gap, since the swallowed text is nominally covered) now still produces STRUCTURAL_ANALYSIS_INSUFFICIENT + RAW_SOURCE_COVENANT_SIGNAL findings via the new boundary-anomaly route (test E2/E3). A genuinely healthy document produces zero such findings (E4, no false-positive explosion).

q5Remediation.description: A lettered clause placed directly under an ARTICLE with no intervening SECTION previously got no node at all and reported STRUCTURE_HEALTHY (no rank/level sanity check existed).
q5Remediation.fix: IMPLAUSIBLE_HIERARCHY_RANK (ERROR) health check added to structural-index.ts: a parent/child edge skipping more than one nesting rank now raises a signal.

siblingSpanOverlapRemediation.description: Two SIBLING nodes with overlapping [charStart,charEnd) previously produced zero health findings.

p110Q3Determination.mechanism: An in-text citation shaped like a real heading (e.g. '...permitted under Section 6.05 Reserved. and subject to...') is accepted by stage-structure.ts as a genuine top-level SECTION raw node. stage-structure.ts's clause-tree region-slicing and its single global rank-based stack pass both treat this spurious node as a legitimate rank-1 boundary, popping the real enclosing section early and re-parenting its own later lettered clauses under the spurious node instead.
p110Q3Determination.whyNoCorrectionThisPhase: The fix belongs in stage-structure.ts's rank-stack/region-slicing construction - not in Workstream A's assigned files (structural-coverage.ts/raw-source-fallback.ts/coverage-audit/pipeline.ts/structural-index.ts health-diagnostics only), and the phase charter explicitly says a parser redesign for Q3 is not authorized in this remediation phase. Health-diagnostics are read-only findings; they cannot reassign parentNodeId.
candidateDesigns: Plausibility gate before a same/shallower-rank pop (smallest blast radius, heuristic, could misfire on legitimate non-monotonic numbering)

Two-pass parse: validate ARTICLE/SECTION raws against a numbering-sequence/position sanity check before clause-tree region slicing runs (cleaner separation, larger blast radius - changes clause-tree's region-boundary contract)

Confidence-tagged raws with deferred acceptance: tag citation-shaped ambiguous matches as low-confidence, only high-confidence raws close/open rank-stack entries (most surgical, needs a StructuralNode shape change reviewed separately)
p110Q3Determination.affectedInvariants: Architecture Invariant #18's own precedent (shared-substrate defect defeating independent-seeming systems) reproduced a second time. Blast radius: discovery (candidates anchored to wrong section), context-retrieval (wrong parent/sibling traversal). Package-graph unaffected (doesn't consume clause-level parenting). Coverage-audit now partially mitigated by the detection signal below.
p110Q3Determination.boundedMitigationImplemented: SECTION_NUMBER_SEQUENCE_ANOMALY (INFO, non-gating) health check: fires when two same-parent SECTION siblings' decimal numbers share a major component but decrease. Confirmed on the exact Q3 fixture; silent on the Q3b control and a legitimate '6.01A' insertion. Detection-only - does not correct the misattachment, only surfaces a lead. Real-data confirmation: fires exactly 4 times on CONMED and 27 times on DSGR (fully explaining the entire infoFindings delta from the pre-remediation baseline for both packages - see KNOWN_PACKAGE_FOUNDATION_REPLAY artifact).

testRunOutput.resultAtWorkstreamCompletion: 96 passed / 24 failed (all pre-existing DATABASE_URL-unavailable failures in that isolated worktree, 0 regressions), 1071 passed / 27 failed(DB) / 95 skipped tests
testRunOutput.resultAfterFullIntegration: See 09-real-postgres-certification.json and the overall full-suite result in 14-phase-3f1-4-final-verdict.json (177 files / 1739 tests / 0 failures with real Postgres available)

residualLimitations: EMBEDDED_HEADING_LIKE_FRAGMENT only catches heading-defeat mechanisms shaped like a real Section/ARTICLE keyword match with a colon/period variant - a fully non-standard garbling is not caught (matches what the real parser itself can never see either, not a regression).

SIGNAL_DENSITY_SHIFT's 2-distinct-marker threshold has a known, accepted false-positive shape (ordinary prose citing two different lettered clauses together) - cost is bounded (one extra raw-scan pass, health capped at PARTIAL), not a wrong answer.
Q3's underlying misattachment (not just its detection) is not corrected - see ARCHITECTURE_CHANGE_REQUIRED above.
SECTION_NUMBER_SEQUENCE_ANOMALY is a heuristic that could theoretically false-positive on a legitimate non-decimal renumbering convention.
